azure-sdk-for-python.reason: monorepo umbrella; ships as many azure-* packages, no single package represents it

cloud-init.reason: installed via distro images, not pip

cpython.reason: not pip-installable; the cpython PyPI name was squatted

devpi.reason: devpi is a deprecated metapackage; the server package carries real usage

django-ai-plugins.reason: GitHub-only so far; young project, remap if it publishes

django-db-models.reason: part of Django, not a package

django-rest-framework.reason: django-rest-framework is a dead alias package

django-rules.reason: PyPI django-rules is an abandoned unrelated fork; dfunckt's project publishes as rules

geodjango.reason: part of Django (django.contrib.gis), not a package

google-cloud-python.reason: monorepo umbrella; ships as many google-cloud-* packages

graphify.reason: GitHub-only so far; young project, remap if it publishes

httpx-url.reason: class in the httpx package, not a package

jinja.reason: PyPI jinja is Jinja1; current releases publish as jinja2

micropython.reason: interpreter distributed as firmware builds, not pip

odoo.reason: self-hosted suite installed from odoo.com, not pip

pyenv.reason: installed via git/homebrew; PyPI pyenv is a defunct shim

pypy.reason: interpreter distributed via pypy.org, not pip

python-patterns.reason: reference repo, not a package; PyPI name held by unrelated 2012 project

pytorch.reason: PyPI pytorch is a squatter; real package is torch

renpy.reason: distributed via renpy.org; PyPI name was squatted, now 404

sentry-skills.reason: agent skills repo, not a package

strawberry.reason: PyPI strawberry is an unrelated bookmarking service

trailofbits-skills.reason: agent skills repo, not a package

uv-audit.reason: part of uv (the `uv audit` subcommand); PyPI uv-audit is an unrelated third-party tool by rocshers

warehouse.reason: the PyPI server itself; deployed, not pip-installed

winpython.reason: distribution with its own installer; PyPI name is a 2012 relic
